subject: Clarify compliance gating for KMS & audit delivery — Aurelia POC
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena@aureliahealth.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: security@aureliahealth.com
Date: 2026-09-12T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Compliance questions for POC: audit logs, BYOK, SSO

Hi Stephanie / Ben,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Before we kick off the POC we need to confirm a few security controls from the outset so we can sign our internal paperwork:

- Can Redwood stream per-tenant audit logs to our S3 bucket (preferrably encrypted server-side) or push to our Splunk instance? What format and delivery cadence do you support?
- For the private deployment option, do you support customer-managed keys (BYOK) using our KMS? If not fully supported during POC, what workaround would you recommend?
- How does user mapping look for SSO (SAML/SCIM)? We need email->workspace role mapping and audit events that include the SAML subject.

I've attached a short spreadsheet that lists our minimum evidentiary requirements and retention windows.

Appreciate a short note on feasibility and a rough timeline — our security team needs to approve by 9/20 to stay on track.

Thanks,
Elena
Director of Security
Aurelia Health
[Attachment: aurelia-compliance-asks.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@aureliahealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-12T12:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Compliance questions for POC: audit logs, BYOK, SSO

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Marissa (product) and Jonas (security) to triage scope and blockers.

High level:
- Audit export: we can stream audit events to an S3 sink (newline-delimited JSON) and also offer webhook pushes (for SIEM) via a secure connector. We'll confirm encryption mode (SSE-KMS vs SSE-S3).
- BYOK: Private deployments support CMK wrapping; for hosted POC we can do a temporary escrow approach where logs are encrypted client-side before ingestion. Jonas, please confirm feasibility and the short-term compromise.
- SSO: Redwood supports SAML + SCIM. We can include SAML subject in audit events. Need to confirm attribute mapping names with your IdP.

Next steps:
1) Jonas to confirm BYOK/escrow steps and deliverables by 9/16.
2) Marissa to propose minimal retention options and a lightweight audit schema by 9/15.
3) Quick bridge (30m) with Aurelia security — can we do 9/14 09:00 PT?

Attachments: intake checklist + link to our product doc.

— Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@aureliahealth.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-13T09:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Compliance questions for POC: audit logs, BYOK, SSO

On Sat, Sep 12, 2026 at 12:18 PM Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Elena — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Marissa (product) and Jonas (security) to triage scope and blockers.

Thanks — a few product clarifications from my side to keep the POC scoped and unblock engineering: 

- Audit schema: we'll surface per-request fields (timestamp, tenant_id, user_email, action, resource, request_id, ip, user_agent, saml_subject). We'll provide a sample NDJSON schema by 9/15. If Aurelia needs additional fields we can add them to a filterable extension object.
- Delivery cadence: supports near-real-time push (webhook) and batch delivery to S3 hourly or daily. For Splunk we recommend the webhook + HEC integration for immediate ingestion.
- Retention options: POC can be configured for 90 / 180 / 365 day tiers. If the account needs >365 we should treat that as an enterprise config with SLA changes.

Risk / fallback: if BYOK wrapping isn't available in our hosted POC, we can encrypt logs at the client side using a provided tool (AES-GCM) and deliver the ciphertext to S3. Key material would be managed by Aurelia outside Redwood. This preserves confidentiality of audit bodies but prevents Redwood from running server-side indexing on those payloads during POC.

I'll attach the sample schema and a short matrix of retention tradeoffs. Can we confirm Aurelia's preferred delivery (S3 vs webhook) on the 9/14 call?

— Marissa
Product Manager, Compliance Integrations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: audit-schema-sample.json (json)]
Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Redwood/POC-Aurelia#schema

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@aureliahealth.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-16T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Compliance questions for POC: audit logs, BYOK, SSO

Elena / team — apologies for the slightly longer turnaround; wanted to validate technical constraints before committing.

Short answer: feasible with a phased approach. Details below and open/asks highlighted.

1) BYOK (private): supported. For private deployments we can integrate with customer KMS (AWS CMK) and configure envelope encryption so audit files at rest are protected by the customer's key. Deliverable: KMS integration guide + terraform snippet.

2) BYOK (hosted POC): not supported out-of-the-box. Proposal: temporary client-side encryption (as Marissa suggested) for the POC. We can provide an SDK helper that will AES-wrap log bodies before transmission. Aurelia retains the key. Tradeoff: Redwood cannot index encrypted payloads.

3) Audit delivery: we will implement an S3 sink (NDJSON) with SSE-KMS support. For webhook/Splunk HEC we will provide mutual-TLS + token auth. Event schema will include saml_subject if your IdP sends it; we need the exact attribute name (e.g., NameID or custom attribute).

4) Evidence & timeline: to satisfy your security sign-off by 9/20 we can deliver:
- A short runbook (SOC2 relevant) showing audit export modes + sample NDJSON (deliverable 9/17)
- KMS integration sketch and temporary SDK helper (deliverable 9/20)

Open asks for Aurelia:
- Confirm S3 bucket ARN and whether Aurelia prefers SSE-KMS or SSE-S3.
- Confirm exact IdP attribute used for SAML subject mapping.

Attachments: kms-integration-sketch.png (high-level), and I'll create INFRA ticket to track engineering work: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INFRA-7891.

If that plan works I can schedule a short handoff with infra next week to start work.

— Jonas
Senior Security Engineer
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: kms-integration-sketch.png (png)]
